8262.title: Queue admission bypasses thread lifecycle
8262.rootCauseOneLine: The shared transactional queue insert does not check current archivedAt or deletedAt before persisting and notifying.

prReviews.verdict: Static inspection supports the lifecycle fence; soft-delete regression coverage is missing. PR code was not executed.

8262.proposedFix: Fence lifecycle state in the common insert transaction and map its typed refusal to an API conflict; retain a real soft-delete regression.
8262.caveats: Complete reproduction is embedded in HTML; raw artifacts remain local per report repository policy. Both clean runs had 2 intended failures and 47 passes. Physical deletion already rejects insertion. No live HTTP race or PR runtime validation. No new fix PR because linked PR 8263 is open.
